summary: States the default: Ansible runs each task on all hosts in the play before the next task, using 5 forks. Change this with a strategy plugin, a different number of forks, or keywords like `serial`.
questions: How many hosts does Ansible run on at once by default?
Does Ansible finish a task on all hosts before moving on?
How can I change how Ansible schedules tasks across hosts?

answer_card.title: Default execution behavior
answer_card.answer_md: By default Ansible runs each task on all hosts in the play before starting the next task on any host, using **5 forks**. To change this, use a different strategy plugin, change the number of forks, or use keywords like `serial`.
